vials.name: BPC-157
vials.desc: Lyophilised pentadecapeptide for in-vitro laboratory research.
vials.chemDesc: Pentadecapeptide fragment of human Body Protection Compound. Sequence: GEPPPGKPADDAGLV. Stable gastric pentadecapeptide; resistant to enzymatic hydrolysis in gastric juice.

vials.name: TB-500
vials.desc: Synthetic peptide fraction of thymosin beta-4.
vials.chemDesc: Synthetic analogue of the actin-sequestering protein Thymosin β-4. 43-amino acid peptide. Promotes actin polymerisation and cellular migration in vitro.

vials.name: Wolverine
vials.desc: Laboratory blend of 10mg BPC-157 and 10mg TB-500 in a single lyophilised vial.
vials.chemDesc: Proprietary dual-peptide lyophilised blend. Contains BPC-157 (CAS 137525-51-0) and TB-500 (CAS 77591-33-4) in a fixed molar ratio. Each component independently verified by HPLC.

vials.name: Retatrutide
vials.desc: Novel multi-target tri-agonist peptide for in-vitro metabolic binding assays.
vials.chemDesc: Triple incretin receptor agonist (GIP-R / GLP-1R / GCGR). C18 fatty diacid-conjugated peptide enabling extended half-life via albumin binding. Investigational compound.

vials.name: Ipamorelin
vials.desc: Pentapeptide growth hormone secretagogue receptor agonist.
vials.chemDesc: Pentapeptide growth hormone secretagogue. Selective GHSR-1a agonist. Contains Aib (α-aminoisobutyric acid) at position 1 conferring proteolytic stability.

vials.name: CJC-1295 + DAC
vials.desc: Long-acting synthetic analog of growth hormone-releasing hormone.
vials.chemDesc: Modified GHRH analogue with Drug Affinity Complex (DAC) technology. Covalent albumin binding via maleimide–thiol reaction extends plasma half-life to approximately 6–8 days.

vials.name: GHK-CU
vials.desc: Naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide with tissue remodeling research applications.
vials.chemDesc: Copper(II) chelate of the tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine. Endogenous plasma peptide. Cu²⁺ coordination via imidazole nitrogen of His and ε-amino group of Lys.

vials.name: GLOW GHK-CU
vials.desc: Advanced 3-compound lyophilised formulation combining GHK-Cu, BPC-157, and TB-500.
vials.chemDesc: High-concentration GHK-Cu formulation (70 mg/vial). Identical molecular structure to standard GHK-Cu (CAS 49557-75-7). Elevated dose per vial for intensive in vitro protocols.

vials.name: NAD+
vials.desc: Essential cellular coenzyme for mitochondrial and cellular longevity research.
vials.chemDesc: Oxidised form of nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide. Essential coenzyme in cellular redox reactions. Substrate for sirtuins (SIRT1–7), PARP enzymes, and CD38 NADase.

vials.name: Bacteriostatic Water
vials.desc: Multi-dose sterile water container preserved with 0.9% benzyl alcohol.
vials.storage: Store at 15–25 °C; discard 28 days after first use
vials.chemDesc: Water for injection preserved with 0.9% w/v benzyl alcohol (CAS 100-51-6). Bacteriostatic agent inhibits microbial growth. Suitable for multi-dose reconstitution of lyophilised peptides.

vials.name: Tirzepatide
vials.desc: Dual glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide and glucagon-like peptide-1 agonist.
vials.sequence: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist peptide — C20 fatty diacid conjugate
vials.chemDesc: Dual incretin receptor agonist (GIP-R / GLP-1R). 39-amino acid peptide with Aib substitution at position 2. C20 fatty diacid moiety enables once-weekly dosing via albumin binding.

vials.name: Epithalon
vials.desc: Synthetic peptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) studied for telomerase activation.
vials.chemDesc: Synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly). Analogue of epithalamin, a polypeptide isolated from bovine pineal gland. Reported to stimulate telomerase activity in somatic cells in vitro.

vials.name: SS-31
vials.desc: Mitochondria-targeting synthetic tetrapeptide for cellular bioenergetics research.
vials.chemDesc: Szeto-Schiller tetrapeptide. Mitochondria-targeted antioxidant peptide. Selectively concentrates in the inner mitochondrial membrane via electrostatic interaction with cardiolipin.
